notes:
High-level: enterprise-facing CX automation vendor. Focused on 24/7 contact centers (finance + telco customers).

Discovery notes:
- 2025-09-14: inbound from VP Product after benchmarking costs on existing LLM provider.
- Wants RAG layer across multi-source KBs (Zendesk + Confluence + internal DB) with provenance/citation per suggestion.
- Primary workloads: agent assist (real-time suggested replies), ticket summarization (end-of-shift digest), automated tool-calling (close tickets, escalate, attach KB links).
- Peak characteristics: predictable baseline + sudden spikes (marketing campaigns, outages) -> need graceful degradation and fallback routing.

Technical constraints / ask:
- Latency SLOs: 95th perc < 300ms for agent-assist suggestions; background summarization ok at 2-4s.
- Throughput target: 120 concurrent agents / 10k messages per hour normal; ability to handle 3x during spikes.
- Citation & freshness: want per-suggestion citations + TTLs; must surface source and last-updated timestamp.
- Multi-source retrieval: need connectors for Zendesk, Confluence, S3 object store, proprietary DB. Relevance tuning + reranker mandatory.
- Security: must support SAML SSO, SCIM, audit logs, customer-managed KMS for embeddings at rest, and EU data residency for EU customers.

Commercial / process:
- Interested in Dedicated for predictable throughput; evaluating hybrid: Hosted API low-latency edge + Dedicated pools for spikes.
- Budget: expect to commit once POC demonstrates <50% cost-on-ops vs current provider and pass security checklist.

Conversation snippets:
- "Need citations for agents — they won't act on hallucinations." (Head of CX)
